name: NVIDIA
role: Designs the dominant AI GPUs; the hub of the whole supply chain.

name: AMD
role: Designs GPUs and CPUs; the main GPU alternative.

name: Intel
role: Designs CPUs and runs its own fabs; turnaround underway, now part-owned by the US government.

name: Broadcom
role: Designs custom AI accelerators and networking silicon; builds Google's TPUs.

name: Marvell Technology
role: Custom AI silicon and interconnect; data center is ~75% of revenue.

name: Arm Holdings
role: Licenses the CPU IP most AI systems are built on; ~97% gross margin.

name: TSMC
role: Fabricates and packages nearly all leading-edge AI silicon.

name: Samsung
role: HBM memory (tertiary supplier) and a foundry competitor.

name: SK Hynix
role: NVIDIA's primary HBM supplier; ~62% HBM share.

name: Micron
role: US-based HBM supplier; share growing off a small base.

name: ASML
role: Sole maker of EUV lithography machines; the hardest chokepoint in the chain.

name: Applied Materials
role: Wafer-fabrication and deposition equipment.

name: Dell
role: Integrates chips into finished servers and racks.

name: Supermicro
role: Server and rack integration for AI clusters.

name: Arista
role: Networking switches that connect racks; runs on Broadcom silicon.

name: Microsoft
role: Hyperscaler and OpenAI's original backer; building its own Maia chips.

name: Amazon
role: Hyperscaler and Anthropic's core partner; building Trainium chips.

name: Google
role: Hyperscaler and model lab; designs its own TPUs via Broadcom.

name: Oracle
role: Cloud provider anchoring Stargate.

name: Meta
role: Hyperscaler and open-model leader; multi-gigawatt superclusters.

name: CoreWeave
role: Neocloud; NVIDIA holds an equity stake and it buys NVIDIA GPUs.

name: OpenAI
role: The largest single buyer of compute.

name: Anthropic
role: Frontier lab with a multi-vendor chip strategy.

name: xAI
role: Frontier lab; built the Colossus cluster fast.

name: SoftBank
role: Mega-investor funding OpenAI, Stargate, and power buildout.

name: HUMAIN
role: Saudi Arabia's PIF-backed national AI champion.

name: G42
role: UAE's state-linked AI firm.

name: US Government
role: Sets chip export policy; now an Intel shareholder.

name: Shin-Etsu
role: World's largest silicon-wafer maker; also photoresists and photomask blanks.

name: SUMCO
role: Pure-play silicon-wafer maker; polished and epitaxial 300mm wafers.

name: Linde
role: World's largest industrial-gases company; ultra-high-purity gases piped on-site into fabs.

name: Lam Research
role: Etch and deposition equipment; the memory makers' indispensable tool vendor.

name: KLA
role: Process-control and yield-management leader; inspection and metrology for every leading fab.

name: Tokyo Electron
role: Coater/developer leader, plus etch and deposition; a top-three tool vendor.

name: ASE Technology
role: World's largest OSAT; advanced packaging and test for fabless chipmakers.

name: Amkor
role: Largest US-headquartered OSAT; ~$12B advanced-packaging campus rising in Peoria, Arizona.

name: Vertiv
role: Data-center power and cooling infrastructure; partnered with NVIDIA on AI-factory designs.

name: Eaton
role: Intelligent power management; UPS and electrical distribution for data centers.

name: Nebius
role: Neocloud GPU provider spun out of Yandex; $17.4B Microsoft capacity deal.
